## Summary
In the binary reader, `get_to()`/`unexpect_eof()`, `last_byte_error()` and several size/type helpers built `parse_error`/`out_of_range` exceptions and temporary `std::string`s inline. That kept `get_to()` from being inlined into `get_number()` (0xd0-byte frame), so every multi-byte read cost two calls.

- `report_eof()` (noinline) shared by `get_to()` and `unexpect_eof()`
- `last_byte_error()`/`unexpected_byte()` take `const char*` contexts (no string temporaries at call sites); one `last_byte_error()` with an optional tail for "…; last byte: 0x…" messages (folded; no separate `_tail` helper or `const char*` overload)
- out-of-line helpers for container size, number overflow, optimized-type and BSON errors; `container_too_large_error()` in `json_sax.hpp`

Messages, exception ids, positions and the values passed to `sax->parse_error()` are unchanged. Parser/serializer/writer showed no stable gain and are not touched.

## Numbers
Apple clang 21, -O2, min of 5 alternating runs vs. develop (4e294f4b1):

| | citm | twitter | canada |
|---|---|---|---|
| from_ubjson | −7.5 % | −6.5 % | −0.9 % |
| from_bjdata | −6.5 % | −5.9 % | −0.6 % |
| from_bson | −4.9 % | −5.2 % | −4.9 % |
| from_cbor | −2.5 % | −2.6 % | −1.6 % |
| from_msgpack | −2.0 % | −1.9 % | −2.1 % |
| from_bon8 | −3.1 % | −1.2 % | −1.0 % |

Re-measured after folding `last_byte_error_tail` into `last_byte_error` (best of 30, 3 alternating rounds, % vs. develop; old = previous PR head 7054cebe6, new = 526b4c155):

| | citm old/new | twitter old/new | canada old/new |
|---|---|---|---|
| from_cbor | −2.3 / −2.7 | −1.3 / +0.7 | −2.8 / −3.3 |
| from_msgpack | −2.0 / −1.6 | −1.3 / −0.7 | −3.7 / −3.9 |
| from_ubjson | −5.2 / −5.2 | −5.1 / −4.5 | −2.7 / −2.5 |
| from_bson | −5.7 / −5.7 | −3.3 / −3.3 | −5.0 / −5.0 |

The gain is unchanged. The other single-use wrappers (BSON length/document-size/unsupported-type, optimized-type, container-size) stay: each builds a string (`concat`/`to_string`/hex) that would otherwise return to a hot function.

Writers/parse/dump are within noise. GCC 16 (earlier measurement, not re-run here): from_cbor −4–6 %.

## Tests
unit-cbor, msgpack, ubjson, bjdata, bson, bon8, class_parser, deserialization, regression2, disabled_exceptions, diagnostics, msgpack-cpp17 pass locally; single_include regenerated.

## Breaking changes
None. No public API change.

comments.body:
Written by Claude Code on behalf of @nlohmann.

Review follow-up (526b4c155): `last_byte_error_tail` is folded into `last_byte_error` (optional `tail` argument, appended as `<detail><tail>; last byte: 0x<token>`), and the `const char*` overload is gone, so there is one helper instead of three. Error ids, messages and byte positions are unchanged: unit-cbor/msgpack/ubjson/bjdata/bson/bon8 pass against the full test data. I kept the BSON, optimized-type and container-size wrappers because each builds a string that would otherwise go back into a hot function. Re-measured with Apple clang -O2 against develop and the previous head: the speedups are unchanged (details in the description).

title: Move binary reader error construction out of line
